rev.t: I had an amazing experience at Giva, they have good collection and the staff who handled our purchases was very good and well behaved. Kavitha was too soft and helped us a lot.

I purchased three items in total two chains and one earring set. Syed explained everything very clearly and gave us a good discount. He patiently explained the gold and diamond pricing, as well as the exchange and return policies. …

I had a wonderful experience shopping for silver jewellery at GIVA. The collection was beautiful, with elegant designs and good quality products. A special mention to Adiba, who assisted me throughout the purchase. She was very friendly, …
